eps.t: Why Is There So Much Legalese in Magic!?
eps.ov: Surrounded by her favorite things, Anzu gets ready to immerse herself in a new video game. But she quickly notices that the game is not what it seems.
eps.ta: لماذا في السحر كل هذه اللغة القانونية!؟
eps.oa: تستعد «أنزو»، وحولها كل ما تحبه، لتنغمس في لعبة فيديو جديدة. لكنها سرعان ما تلحظ أن اللعبة ليست كما تبدو.

eps.t: It's Time for Children to Go to Sleep
eps.ov: Horrified to find a cockroach in her house, Anzu escapes to a nearby park only to be met by a sudden torrential rain. To her dismay, Tsukasa passes by.
eps.oa: ترتاع «أنزو» حين تجد صرصوراً في بيتها، فتفر إلى حديقة قريبة، فيفاجئها مطر غزير. ولسوء حظها يمر «تسوكاسا».

eps.t: My Life Has Become a Dating Sim
eps.ov: Anzu dreams about her dear Momohiki, then wakes up to a mortifying reality. Tsukasa checks up on his apartment and is shocked by what he finds.
eps.oa: تحلم «أنزو» بقطها العزيز «موموهيكي»، ثم تفيق على واقع محرج. ويتفقد «تسوكاسا» شقته فيصدمه ما يجده.

eps.t: The Childhood Friend Is Easy Mode
eps.ov: Flustered by the sudden appearance of Junta, Anzu angrily confronts Riri. But the mischievous tiny wizard has a few more tricks in store for them.
eps.oa: يربك «أنزو» ظهور «جونتا» المفاجئ، فتواجه «ريري» غاضبة. لكن الساحر الصغير العابث يخبئ لهما حيلاً أخرى.

eps.t: You're More Troublesome in Flesh and Blood
eps.ov: After bumping into Junta and Tsukasa, Riri organizes a spontaneous dinner at Anzu's house and tries to stir up some unwelcome romantic tension.
eps.oa: بعد أن يصادف «جونتا» و«تسوكاسا»، يرتب «ريري» عشاءً مرتجلاً في بيت «أنزو»، ويحاول أن يثير بينهم توتراً عاطفياً لا يرحب به أحد.

eps.ov: As the unlikely trio start their life together, Anzu finds herself a job to distract herself from Riri's schemes but ends up on an impromptu date.
eps.ta: موعد من نوع الانتقال إلى عالم آخر
eps.oa: يبدأ الثلاثي غير المتوقع حياتهم معاً، فتجد «أنزو» عملاً تلهي به نفسها عن مكائد «ريري»، لكنها تنتهي إلى موعد مرتجل.

eps.ov: After the accident, Anzu shows up to school with the rich and handsome Hijiri Koganei, attracting unwanted attention from her nosy classmates.

eps.t: Goose Bumps! I Am a Goose Now
eps.ov: When a rowdy man accuses Anzu of spilling his coffee, a beautiful savior comes to the rescue. Meanwhile, Riri comes up with a plan to speed up progress.

eps.t: Ginger Ale Is a Force Majeure
eps.ov: On her way home from school, Anzu bumps into two childhood friends. As they catch up on old times at a nearby cafe, she has a revelation about Junta.
Chased out of her home by her unruly big brother, Saki turns up at Anzu's house. Riri nudges everyone to go on a summer outing together.

eps.t: Just Tell Me if You Don't Like It
eps.ov: Anzu, Hijiri and his chauffer have a fun day at a game center. Later, a mysterious woman approaches Anzu and introduces herself.
Cornered by Yukana Kishi, Anzu finds herself in a dangerous situation. Worried about her whereabouts, her friends scramble to find her.
